title: MediPFN: Amortized In-Context Nuisance Learning and Inference for Causal Mediation Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.13219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal mediation analysis decomposes a treatment effect into indirect pathways through mediators and direct pathways through other processes. Tabular foundation models perform classification and regression through in-context learning, providing estimates of conditional means and propensity scores used in causal mediation analysis. Constructing confidence intervals from these estimates requires accounting for uncertainty introduced by fitting and combining several nuisance functions. We introduce MediPFN, an amortized inference framework that adapts a pretrained tabular foundation model to nuisance prediction and combines its predictions through a cross-fitted influence-function estimator. A separate head learns quantiles of the estimator's standardized error from simulated tables with known indirect effects. translated_title: MediPFN：面向因果中介分析的摊销式上下文干扰学习与推断
translated_abstract: 因果中介分析将处理效应分解为通过中介变量的间接路径和通过其他过程的直接路径。表格基础模型通过上下文学习执行分类和回归，为因果中介分析提供条件均值和倾向得分的估计。基于这些估计构建置信区间时，需要考虑拟合和组合多个干扰函数所引入的不确定性。我们提出MediPFN，这是一个摊销推断框架，它将预训练的表格基础模型适配于干扰预测任务，并通过交叉拟合的影响函数估计器组合其预测结果。一个单独的输出头从具有已知间接效应的模拟表格中学习估计器标准化误差的分位数。随后，通过监督微调、对称化以及独立校准来生成置信区间。我们建立了覆盖保证……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MediPFN通过将预训练表格基础模型适配于干扰函数预测，并结合交叉拟合影响函数估计器与独立校准机制，为因果中介分析提供具有覆盖保证的置信区间。
en_tdlr: MediPFN adapts a pretrained tabular foundation model for nuisance prediction in causal mediation analysis, combining a cross-fitted influence-function estimator with independent calibration to produce confidence intervals with coverage guarantees.
